text:
incident-bot: Paging: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate (us-west-2). Error spike started ~4991234500. Current 5xx rate ~11.8% (5m). Alert: https://dash.internal/redwood/alerts/INC-4991 :rotating_light:
oncall-alex: i'm on it. grabbing logs & routing table. pinging @elaine-sre for envoy/edge look.
elaine-sre: oncall ack. i'm checking LB config and recent route changes. do we have a deploy around 4991234000-4991234400?
oncall-alex: deploys: none in the last 30m according to deploy-bot. quick check: k8s ingress + envoy layer changed weights earlier today by infra team.
vinh-eng: i pushed a small weight tweak at 4991229000 to nudge canary to 30% — could be related if route mapping overlapped.
elaine-sre: looking at envoy stats from a couple of gateway hosts: 
```
server1: cluster.upstream_rq_5xx: 523
server1: cluster.upstream_rq_timeout: 12
server2: cluster.upstream_rq_5xx: 510
server2: cluster.upstream_rq_timeout: 9
```
elaine-sre: 5xx is coming back from upstream (backend), not bottle-necked at edge. but i see retry amplification on the gateway. retry_count is high.
oncall-alex: can you paste the active retry policy for the cluster?
elaine-sre: current cluster config snippet: 
```yaml
retry_policy:
  retry_on: "5xx,connect-failure,refused-stream"
  num_retries: 3
  per_try_timeout: 2s
```
elaine-sre: amplification path: backend intermittent 502s + gateway retries => cascade.
oncall-alex: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily set num_retries: 0 in gateway for affected cluster 2) reduce canary weight back to 0 (restore stable pool) 3) throttle traffic to slow path if needed. i'll make the change and roll.
vinh-eng: i'm ready to rollback the weight change. if we remove canary traffic that should reduce pressure on the mid-tier.
ops-bot: ran: kubectl -n infra set env deployment/envoy GATEWAY_RETRY_NUM=0 (dry-run)
oncall-alex: executing now: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-cluster --patch '{"data":{"retry_policy":"num_retries: 0"}}'
```
oncall-alex: applied. propagating. restarting envoy pods gracefully.
elaine-sre: restarting one-by-one: server1 restarted, server2 restarted, server3 rolling. watching metrics...
elaine-sre: immediate drop in retry_count and 5xx volume starting to show. current 5xx ~5.2% (was 11.8%).
sarah-support: field reports: a handful of customers on hosted API saw elevated errors in last 20m, CS triage ticket created: CS-9087. customers impacted mainly on high concurrency flows.
oncall-alex: good — notify execs + product that mitigation in progress. i'll open a temporary status note.
ops-bot: status page update draft: "We are currently mitigating elevated errors affecting generation endpoints in us-west-2. Traffic has been routed to stable pool and retry behavior reduced. We are monitoring."
vinh-eng: i rolled the canary weight back to 0 via ingress control, confirmed with envoy stats (canary_count=0).
elaine-sre: post-change stats: 
```
500 -> 5xx count trend: 11.8% -> 5.2% -> 2.1% over 18m
upstream_timeout: down from 12 -> 3
retry_count: from 2200 -> 120
```
elaine-sre: looks like upstream intermittency + retry amplification were main drivers. need to follow up with the backend owners to root cause 502s.
oncall-alex: handing off active incident to @elaine-sre for post-mitigation verification and RCA. i'm pausing paging in 30m unless it regresses.
elaine-sre: taking over. next steps: 1) open infra ticket (INFRA-3131) to investigate upstream service 502s and connect timeouts 2) add short-term circuit-breaker caps to avoid cascade (max_connections and pending requests) 3) schedule postmortem 4) recommend permanent change: default retries=0 for gateway when upstream is known to be flaky, with a canaryed retry policy per-service.
sarah-support: CS note updated: customers with elevated errors advised to retry later; we have CS-9087 tracking outreach.
oncall-alex: thanks all, excellent rapid mitigation. tagging for follow-up: @vinh-eng (canary change), @backend-owner (please review 502 causes), @product-eng for customer comms.
incident-bot: incident annotated: mitigated -> partial, mitigation_time: 4991234600, incident_ticket: INC-4991, bookmarks: https://dash.internal/INC-4991
elaine-sre: leaving runbook items in INFRA-3131. will include exact envoy diff + kubectl commands used. copy here: 
```
# set retries to 0
kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-cluster --patch '{"data":{"retry_policy":"num_retries: 0"}}'
# rollback canary weight
kubectl -n ingress set image deploy/canary-proxy --record --dry-run=client
# restart envoy pods gracefully
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/envoy
```
elaine-sre: postmortem owners: elaine-sre, vinh-eng, backend-owner. ETA for postmortem draft: EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: note: auto-pager will re-enable if 5xx > 5% over 10m.
elaine-sre: closing live handoff. leaving incident in monitoring state. will update ticket when RCA ready. :white_check_mark:
